title: Audio
subtitle: Beds and effects: listen, look at the numbers, check the sprite map, and sign the listening yourself.
notice: No agent can listen. Every figure and picture here is measured; whether it sounds right is yours to judge, and only a person in this page can sign it off.
library.label: Library
view.label: Views
empty.title: Choose a cue
empty.body: Pick a bed or an effect on the left. Stage tells you how far it got: planned (a design only), master only (a WAV exists), packed (in an Ogg and AAC pack). Listening is separate and only a person sets it.
summary.caption: Library totals
cue.planned: This cue is planned: there is no master yet, so there is nothing to play or measure.
side.label: Numbers and sign-off
side.title: Numbers and sign-off
side.none: Pick a cue to see its numbers and listening checklist.
listen.noVersion: This version is not available for this cue.
listen.noDecoder: This browser may not decode this format.
listen.x3Hint: Plays the loop region three times, so the join is heard twice.
listen.seamHint: Starts 4 s before the loop end and runs through the seam.
listen.triggerHint: Plays the effect now, over the bed if it is running (unmatched, as in the game).
listen.bedPlaying: {bed} is looping. Trigger the effect over it.
listen.noBed: No bed is available to play under it.
listen.decodeFailed: The {codec} could not be decoded here: {message}
listen.lengthDiffers: Browser decoded {browser} frames; the pack records {pack}.
listen.waveNote: Waveform of the master. The line follows playback of the master or its decoded version.
blind.title: Blind A/B: can this be told from its closest neighbour?
blind.help: Two cues play level-matched as 1 and 2 in a random order. Say which one is the cue under review, {n} times. Chance level is half right.
blind.noPartner: No other effect with a master to compare with.
blind.question: Trial {n} of {total}: which one is {id}?
blind.result: {correct} of {n} right (chance of that by guessing: {p}).
blind.verdict.confusable: They could not be told apart reliably: treat as confusable.
pictures.help: Drawn by studio/audio from the master. Pixels map back to time and frequency by the legend below.
pictures.axes: {framesPerPx} frames per pixel. Spectrogram: logarithmic frequency {min}–{max} Hz, colour range {lo} to {hi} dB.
num.caption: Numbers
num.noLedger: No ledger figures found for this cue; only live measurements are shown.
num.method: Measured here with the studio's own BS.1770-4 meter. ✓ agrees with the recorded figure within its tolerance, ≠ differs.
pack.heading: Pack evidence
pack.title: {pack} (revision {revision})
pack.head: Head offset
check.seam: The seam is clean: no click, no added beat (looped ×3)
check.codecs: Ogg and AAC sound the same as the master
check.distinct: Not confused with its neighbours (blind A/B)
check.onset: The onset is intact: no clipped start
check.hint.headTail: Play from the start and let it finish.
check.hint.mono: Tick Fold to mono and play.
check.hint.codecs: Switch between Master, Ogg and AAC while playing.
check.hint.distinct: Run the blind A/B below Listen.
check.hint.tail: Play solo and let it finish.
check.hint.overBed: Start a bed and trigger the effect.
sign.title: Listening sign-off
sign.help: Only you can sign. It is recorded for this exact master, by its hash, in the Review tab's store.
sign.sign: Sign: I listened, it is good
sign.heardNone: Nothing played in this page yet.
sign.unavailable: Sign-off needs the Review tab's store, which this studio does not have.
sign.state.stale: Signed for an earlier master: listen again.
sprite.none: This cue is not in a pack, so there is no sprite sheet.
sprite.help: {pack}: one sheet of {frames} frames ({seconds} s). Hatched areas are guard gaps (guard {guard} frames). Click a cue to play it from the sheet.
sprite.caption: Cue positions in source frames
sprite.units: Frames are sample frames per channel; ends are exclusive. Decoded columns are the markers measured on each codec's decode.
sprite.noIssues: No overlaps, and every gap is at least the guard ({guard} frames, {ms} ms).
sprite.issue.gap: Gap before {id} is {frames} frames, below the guard.
sprite.issue.leadGap: The sheet starts {frames} frames before {id}: less than the guard.
sprite.issue.past: {id} runs past the end of the sheet.
sprite.issue.trailGap: Only {frames} frames follow {id}: less than the guard.
patch.none: This cue has no patch or score in the engine's format.
patch.ledger: Its delivered source is described in {path}.
patch.help: The document the engine renders. Change a number, render a preview into a scratch folder, and compare it with the delivered master. Delivered files are never touched.
patch.outOfScale: {n} note(s) fall outside the declared scale.
